admin.title: iMIX · Admin
admin.revenueNote: The currencies are not added together: there is no exchange rate in this system, every price is set by hand.
admin.variantsNote: Both languages and both prices are required for every variant: there is no exchange rate in this system, so neither price can be derived from the other.
admin.slugHint: Part of the URL: lowercase words joined by hyphens.
admin.taglineHint: One line under the name on the category page. May be left empty.
admin.navImageHint: A small cutout on a plain ground. Empty falls back to the first photo.
admin.variantSold: This variant has been ordered — set its stock to zero instead of deleting it.
admin.categoriesNote: The slug becomes part of the category URL. A category holding products cannot be deleted.
admin.categoryProducts: {count, plural, =0 {no products} one {# product} other {# products}}
admin.categoryNotEmpty: Move or delete its products first.
admin.ordersNote: Orders in both currencies sit side by side — every amount is printed next to its own currency. Paid and failed are written by the payment webhook, not from here.
admin.homeTilesNote: Tiles render in this order. Two consecutive halves become one row; a half with no partner is drawn full width.
admin.tileKeyHint: A stable name for the seed and for migrations. Never appears in a URL.
admin.tileImageNote: One image covering the whole tile. Its upper third must be empty — the copy sits there.
admin.altHint: Empty means the image is decorative.
admin.actionsNote: Two at most: one primary, one ghost. A button is either complete — both languages and a link — or empty: a half-filled one is never shown.
admin.colorsNote: A colour belongs to the product and variants point at it. Photos are uploaded per colour: 256GB and 512GB in lavender are the same device.
admin.noColors: No colours yet. Without them the product counts as single-finish and the storefront shows no swatches.
admin.colorSlugHint: Lowercase words joined by hyphens. Locked once variants point at it.
admin.colorImagesHint: Empty falls back to the product’s own photos in the gallery.
admin.colorInUse: Variants still point at this colour — move them to another one first.
